entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene. A strong transparent blue spherical barrier around a small standing mage, an outside orange magical bolt dissolving on sphere surface. Sphere outline broad and dark edged, no physical weapon blocked.
